result.title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
result.summary: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene. Here we present a model that directly co-generates the video and 3D motion for any supplied rig, along with a camera that registers this motion to the scene. Prior video-motion models either handle only human skeletons, often adding billions of parameters, or triangulate 3D motion from generated 2D pose maps. We instead keep 3D motion in a separate model that supports arbitrary skeletons, and connect it to a pretrained video model through a small set of cross-attention layers. This separation lets the motion model first learn how skeletons move from motion-only data, which is easier to obtain and augment than paired video. Additionally, our model learns to locate each joint in the video frames, which lets us recover the camera and place the 3D motion in the scene. To train across many skeletons, we use a generative video editor to place animated 3D assets in scenes suited to their actions, curating the edits so their known motion remains valid. Together with human and robot video, this yields nearly 200K training pairs. Our evaluations demonstrate that our model animates diverse rigs from text more faithfully than video-first pipelines, and its motion responds to the surrounding scene. It also turns video into rig motion, rig motion into video, and enables keyframe-based control of the 3D motion. Videos and additional results are available on our project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/par/projects/jca/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一个联合生成视频与任意骨架 3D 运动的模型：运动模型独立学习骨架运动，通过少量 cross-attention 层接入预训练视频模型，并预测关节在帧中的位置以恢复相机、将运动放回 3D 场景。
AI.relevance_reason: 将结构化运动状态放在独立模型中、用少量 cross-attention 与预训练生成骨干对接，并从生成帧回读关节位置，可能为 VLM 中 latent 状态模块的接口设计与「状态是否被使用」的核查提供架构线索。
